title: Autodesk AC1021 FIELD/FIELDLIST graph and TABLE value screen
scope: Screen the exact producer-attributed AutoCAD 2007 AC1021 source for linked FIELD/FIELDLIST identities, the two table-owned field graphs, and expected field results. Determine whether P5-A can reuse this source and what evidence still blocks body-span qualification.

primaryAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.use: FIELD object sequence, child ownership handles, object references, flags, values, and child-value sequence.
FIELDLIST membership sequence and root-dictionary placement.
Versioned CadValue layout used by FIELD values.
AutoCAD 2007 TABLE profile and legacy cell representation.

crossDecoderObjectLengths.limit: This compares decoded object bit lengths. It does not provide per-object starting bit offsets, internal field spans, or the following-object boundary.

expectedValueCrossCheck.method: Use ACadSharp's independently decoded source TABLE quantity and cost cells, multiply each row per the FIELD expression, then sum the row products for each total expression.
expectedValueCrossCheck.limit: The arithmetic cross-check is derived from independently decoded TABLE inputs and the source FIELD expressions. ACadSharp's table output leaves the field-backed TOTAL cells empty; it does not independently evaluate these FIELD expressions or establish their display in AutoCAD.

unresolved: No independent per-object source-body start/end bit cursor was captured for the FIELD records or FIELDLIST.
No independent following-object boundary is bound to the FIELD body-end cursor; matching total bit sizes are not a substitute.
The MText/display graph is structurally linked through field dictionaries, but native AutoCAD rendering and edit behavior are unqualified.
This receipt does not establish strict DXF serialization, fresh DXF-to-DWG roundtrip, general AC1021 support, or a support claim.

implementationReadiness.sourceReuse: Admit this exact AutoCAD 2007 source for P5-A; producer identification, FIELDLIST membership, table ownership graph, and expected expression results are now bound.
implementationReadiness.codeChange: This evidence does not justify a parser or writer change. Typed FIELD/FIELDLIST parse, callback, and encode paths already exist; the strict source-graph route remains unqualified. Do not duplicate the existing paths before exact source-span and graph-closure evidence identifies a concrete gap.
implementationReadiness.nextAction: Capture independent source-body cursor spans for the FIELD/FIELDLIST objects needed by the two TABLE graphs, including the next-object boundary. Crosswalk against ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.76, 20.4.77, 20.4.99, then reuse existing refusal, rollback/retry, and writer selectors to close only the remaining profile graph/output gap.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture or derivative was added to the repository.
